title: Bound same-plane Forest projection reuse before production change

research_question.observation: The same-plane Fourfold adapter retains exact Forest relation digests, but relation retention does not itself establish that every retained edge endpoint belongs to the selected plane. The current path therefore scans/refuses retained hyperedges and undirected edges, then delegates labels to TypedRelationBlock.from_coordinates for endpoint membership and label-position admission before reaching the existing indexed owner.
research_question.candidate: Preserve the current retained-hyperedge/undirected scan and bounded-entry refusal order, collect valid directed endpoints, then perform explicit plane-membership position mapping with the existing unknown-row/unknown-column messages and delegate to TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed. No second validator or trusted constructor is introduced.

bounded_probe.runtime: CPython 3.12.14 on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 / Linux Azure
bounded_probe.measurement: 11 paired same-process AB/BA observations after 3 warmups for each of six deterministic valid complete same-plane fixtures
bounded_probe.semantic_check: Candidate and baseline had to be equal as TypedRelationBlock values, canonical digests and canonical JSON before timing; every timed candidate result had to retain the baseline digest. Six selected semantic cases also required exact outcome/exception-type/message equality.

semantic_cases.name: undirected
semantic_cases.message: binary relation projection requires an explicitly directed ForestEdge

semantic_cases.name: retained-hyperedge
semantic_cases.message: binary relation projection cannot flatten a retained ForestHyperedge

bounded_probe.interpretation: All six bounded valid fixture shapes had a lower candidate median in this one hosted process, while the six selected semantic cases had zero observed mismatches. This is decision evidence for a later same-plane in-place experiment only, not an exhaustive semantic proof or a production/repository-wide speedup claim.

hosted_evidence.checkout_semantics: GitHub pull-request merge preview; not a raw-head checkout claim
hosted_evidence.designated_python_3_12_hash_0: 366 passed, 2 skipped, 1 intentional GPU35 evidence warning

decision: The bounded evidence licenses one later minimal in-place same-plane production experiment only if it preserves the current retained-hyperedge/undirected refusal order, bounded-entry behavior, explicit unknown row/column membership semantics, canonical TypedRelationBlock identity and exact Fourfold subject binding while reusing the existing _from_indexed owner. It does not license a second validator, trusted constructor, or new public API.
next_bounded_packet: If no higher-priority issue supersedes it, implement only the licensed same-plane path in relation_projection.py, add focused precedence and canonical-identity regressions, and reject the change if exact-head integration or bounded evidence does not support it.
